Shipping MAILING LIST Contact Back to site DeathRay $ 139.00 Select option Select option TWO WEEK BULD TIME Qty $ 139.00 Add to cart View cart The DeathRay is my revamped version of the original Death Ray Frequency Mangler and it is sn AWESOME square wave fuzz! This pedal can go from a high filtered squelchy fuzz to a low buzzed out bit crushy mess! The FREQ knob controls the main pitch of the square wave divider while the CYCLE knob slews the duty cycle of the wave.. With the CYCLE knob on full blast the FREQ knob gives more of what you would think a square wave filtered fuzz would sound like, where if you back off on the CYCLE knob you can get all kinds of rad lo-fi tracking blip outs when you let notes ring out! The "Glitch" switch adds even more variables! This sucker can get loud as balls and the OUTPUT knob keeps that under control. But what makes this pedal my absolute favorite is the expression pedal input. Take control of the FREQ knob with foot control for killer synthy tone sweeps! Crazy fun!! Oh yeah, and there's no oscillation noise when the signal is muted. SWEET!!! Kills on guitar or bass!!! Specs: 4.72" x 3.71" x 1.33" 1590BB sized enclosure, true bypass switching, common 9vdc center negative BOSS style power input. Current draw 9mA. Power supply not included. TESTIMONIALS: "The Deathray is my favorite pedal on my board now and it makes such a variety of amazing sounds. It feels like something I always wanted and didn’t know it existed. Tbh I wake up dreaming about it some times…" -Mitch W.
